title: Photos
emptyFavorites: No favourite photos. Press F on a photo or the heart in the viewer.

save.denied: The server doesn’t let you download this original.

memories.title: On This Day
memories.yearsAgo: {n, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} ago

map.title: Map
map.enableBody: The map downloads its tiles from {host}. That service sees the areas where your photos were taken, not the photos.
map.tileUrlHint: An http(s) template with the z, x and y markers in braces, for example your own tile server. Follow the chosen service’s terms of use.
map.tileUrlInvalid: Address refused: it needs an http(s) template with the z, x and y markers.

people.title: People
people.empty: No named people on this server.

sources.title: Photo Folders
sources.keyHint: Create a key in Immich (Account Settings, API Keys) with at least asset.read and asset.view. album.read, person.read, map.read and memory.read add albums, people, the map and memories.
sources.versionTooOld: Immich {version} is too old: Wicaby needs version 2.0 or later.
sources.scopesMissing: Permissions the key lacks: {scopes}. Those features are hidden.
sources.scopeMissing: The API key lacks the {scope} permission; add it in Immich to see this part.
sources.keyRefused: The Immich server refuses the API key. Connect it again in Settings, Sources.
sources.failed: The Immich server answered with an error ({status}).
sources.foot: The key stays encrypted on this computer and is only sent to that server. Immich photos form their own library, next to those from Emby or Jellyfin.

error.server: This server does not answer like an Immich server.
error.scope: The key lacks the asset.read permission the timeline needs.

sources.addBlurb: A folder on this computer, an SMB share or a WebDAV folder. Wicaby reads each photo’s date, orientation and camera (EXIF) once, then only files that changed. Subfolders become albums.
sources.indexing: Indexing… {count, plural, one {# item found} other {# items found}}
sources.indexed: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · last scan {date}
sources.scanFailed: Scan failed: the folder does not answer.
